Photons of energy 12 eV are incident on the cathode of a photoelectric cell. The work function of the surface of the cathode is 5 eV. The maximum kinetic energy of the photoelectrons that reach the anode of the photoelectric cell is 4 eV.          

What is the best estimate for the magnitude of the energy transferred between the electron and the field as the electron travels between the cathode and the anode?
